newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares index falls 1.28 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares index falls 1.28 pct in late trade.

text.p: * Market weighed down by earnings fears
The Manila shares index fell 37.08 points, or 1.28 percent, to 2,869.25 points in late session as investors sold index heavyweights, brokers said.
Kenneth Nerecina, research head of Vickers Ballas Securities (Phils) Inc, said the dim earning prospects of heavy-capitalised issues had weighed down overall market sentiment.
Traders expected the market to slide further on heightened selling pressure. -- MANILA NEWSROOM (63 2) 8418938 Fax 81276267
